turn 1: We are on the Game Freak intro screen. I will press start and a several times to skip the intro, get past the title screen, and start a new game. -> pressed [start start a a a a]
turn 2: Professor Oak is giving his intro speech ('My name is OAK! People call me'). I will press b six times to advance through his dialogue quickly without accidentally opening the custom name entry screen. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 3: Oak is still explaining Pokémon with Nidorino on screen ('For some people, POKéMON are'). I will press b six times to advance through the remaining intro text and land safely on the player name selection menu without accidentally choosing NEW NAME. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 4: We are on the player name menu with the cursor on NEW NAME. I will press down and a to pick RED, then press b four times to advance through the rival intro text and land safely on the rival name selection menu. -> pressed [down a b b b b]
turn 5: Oak is at the end of 'your rival since you were a baby.' with the advance arrow visible. I will press b three times to safely clear the '...Erm, what is his name again?' prompt and land on the rival name menu, then press down and a to pick BLUE, and b to start advancing Oak's final intro dialogue. -> pressed [b b b down a b]
turn 6: Oak says 'remember now! His name is BLUE!' with the advance arrow showing. I will press b six times to clear the final few intro text boxes and enter Red's bedroom. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 7: We are on the very last line of Oak's intro ('with POKéMON awaits! Let's go!'). I will press b to dismiss the text and start the game, then press right and up to head toward the top-right bedroom stairs once the fade-in finishes (skipping the PC Potion to save turns). -> pressed [b right right right up up]
turn 8: We are in Red's bedroom at (5, 4), and the stairs are two tiles right and three tiles up at (7, 1). I will walk right twice and up three times to go downstairs, adding a down press in case the warp finishes quickly. -> pressed [right right up up up down]
turn 9: We are downstairs in Red's house just below the stairs at (7, 2), and the floor along the right side down to row y=6 and over to x=5 is completely clear. I will walk down four tiles and left two tiles to get around Mom and the table, lining up to exit through the front door next turn. -> pressed [down down down down left left]
turn 10: Red is at (5, 6) in the living room, two tiles right and one tile above the right side of the front doormat at (3, 7). I will walk left twice and down twice to step onto the doormat and exit into Pallet Town, then press right twice to start heading east toward the north exit to Route 1 once outside. -> pressed [left left down down right right]
turn 11: We are outside in Pallet Town just east of Red's front door at (7, 6), and the path east and then north between Red's house and Blue's house is completely clear. I will walk right three tiles to align with the Route 1 tall grass exit at x=10, then walk up three tiles toward the north exit to trigger Professor Oak. -> pressed [right right right up up up]
turn 12: We are lined up directly below the left tile of the Route 1 tall grass in Pallet Town, two steps away from entering it. I will walk up twice to step into the grass and trigger Professor Oak's intervention, then press b four times to start clearing his dialogue. -> pressed [up up b b b b]
turn 13: Professor Oak has stopped Red at the Route 1 tall grass and is saying 'Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!'. I will press b six times to clear the rest of his dialogue and trigger the cutscene walk to Oak's Lab. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 14: We have arrived in Professor Oak's Lab and Blue is starting his speech ('BLUE: Gramps! I'm fed up with'). There are many text boxes of dialogue before we gain control to choose Squirtle from the middle Poké Ball, so I will press b six times to advance quickly. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 15: Oak is still explaining the three starter Poké Balls ('There are 3 POKéMON here!'). There are several more text boxes of dialogue between Oak and Blue before we gain control, so I will press b six times to advance quickly through them. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 16: Oak is nearing the end of his starter speech ('have only 3 left, but you can have'), followed by Blue interrupting and Oak telling him to be patient. There are about six text box advances remaining before we gain control, so I will press b six times to clear the rest of the dialogue. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 17: We now have control in Professor Oak's Lab, standing at (4, 4) directly left of the starter table. The middle Poké Ball at (6, 4) holds Squirtle, so I will walk down once, right twice, face up, and press a twice to inspect and confirm Squirtle. -> pressed [down right right up a a]
turn 18: We are viewing page 1 of Squirtle's Pokédex entry. I will press a five times to advance through page 2, close the Pokédex, and confirm YES to choose Squirtle as our starter, followed by a b press to start advancing through the post-selection text without risking a nickname prompt. -> pressed [a a a a a b]
turn 19: We have chosen Squirtle and the screen says 'RED received a SQUIRTLE!'. I will press b six times to dismiss the fanfare text, decline giving Squirtle a nickname, and advance through Blue's cutscene as he picks Bulbasaur. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 20: Blue has just received Bulbasaur and the text box is waiting to be dismissed. Since there are bookshelves below our current column, I will press b to close the text, walk left two tiles into the center aisle, and walk down three tiles to trigger the rival battle with Blue. -> pressed [b left left down down down]
turn 21: We triggered the rival battle with Blue ('BLUE: Wait RED!'). I will press b six times to advance through his pre-battle dialogue, let him walk over, and progress through the battle intro. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 22: The rival battle with Blue has just started and the trainers are sliding into position. Pressing a six times will advance through the opening battle text and immediately select FIGHT and TACKLE once the menu appears. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 23: Squirtle has just been sent out against Blue's Lv 5 Bulbasaur ('Go! SQUIRTLE!'). Squirtle's much higher Defense gives us a strong edge in a Tackle race, and pressing a repeatedly will both advance battle text and automatically select FIGHT and TACKLE. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 24: Squirtle is at 17/20 HP and just used Tackle on Blue's Lv 5 Bulbasaur, which still has most of its HP remaining. I will press a six times to advance through the attack animations and continue using Tackle. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 25: Squirtle is at 14/20 HP against Blue's Lv 5 Bulbasaur, which still has about 80% HP left. Using Tail Whip once will drop Bulbasaur's Defense and boost Tackle's damage enough to win the damage race before Squirtle faints, so I will open FIGHT, select Tail Whip, and use b presses to advance the turn text safely without accidentally using Tail Whip twice. -> pressed [a down a b b b]
turn 26: Squirtle is at 11/20 HP and is currently using Tail Whip to lower Bulbasaur's Defense. Because the move cursor will remember Tail Whip, I will press b twice to finish the turn text, press a to open FIGHT, press up to move the cursor back to Tackle, press a to attack with Tackle, and press b to advance the resulting text safely. -> pressed [b b a up a b]
turn 27: Bulbasaur just used Tackle and dropped Squirtle to 8/20 HP, which confirms our move went through last turn and Squirtle is about to attack with Tackle against Bulbasaur's lowered Defense. With the move cursor back on Tackle, I will press a six times to advance the battle text and keep using Tackle. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 28: Squirtle is at 8/20 HP and just landed Tackle on Bulbasaur, knocking it down to roughly half HP after Tail Whip's Defense drop. Since our cursor is on Tackle and we are on pace to KO Bulbasaur in two more hits before fainting, I will press a six times to keep attacking with Tackle and advance the battle text. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 29: We are on the battle menu with Squirtle at 8/20 HP and Bulbasaur down to less than a third of its HP bar (it likely used Growl instead of attacking). Since the cursor is on FIGHT and our last move was Tackle, pressing a six times will immediately use Tackle and advance through the turn text to finish off Bulbasaur. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 30: Squirtle (8/20 HP) is currently attacking Bulbasaur with Tackle while Bulbasaur has around a quarter of its HP left. Pressing a six times will either advance through the KO, level-up, and victory dialogue if this Tackle finishes Bulbasaur, or immediately select FIGHT and Tackle again if Bulbasaur barely survives. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 31: We are on the battle menu with Squirtle at 5/20 HP and Bulbasaur down to a tiny sliver of HP. Pressing a twice will select FIGHT and Tackle to knock out Bulbasaur, and the remaining a presses will advance through the KO, level-up, and victory text (or immediately use Tackle again in the rare event of a miss). -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 32: Enemy Bulbasaur fainted and Squirtle survived with 2/20 HP to win the rival battle! I will press b six times to advance through the EXP gain, level-up stat screen, prize money, and Blue's post-battle dialogue. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 33: Squirtle leveled up to Lv 6 and we see 'RED defeated BLUE!' on the victory screen. I will press b six times to advance through Blue's defeat quote, the prize money, and his post-battle dialogue in Oak's Lab. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 34: Blue is giving his post-battle speech in Oak's Lab ('BLUE: Okay! I'll make my'). Pressing b four times will clear his remaining lines and trigger his exit cutscene, and pressing down twice afterward will start walking straight toward the lab's front door once we regain control. -> pressed [b b b b down down]
turn 35: We have regained control in Professor Oak's Lab, standing three tiles above the exit mat in the center aisle. I will walk down four times to step onto the mat and exit into Pallet Town, then walk left twice to begin rounding the west side of Oak's Lab toward Route 1. -> pressed [down down down down left left]
turn 36: We are outside Professor Oak's Lab in Pallet Town, standing just below its southwest corner. The column immediately to our left is completely clear alongside the lab's west wall, so I will step left once and walk up five tiles to head north toward Route 1. -> pressed [left up up up up up]
turn 37: We are in Pallet Town at (9, 7), one tile left of the x=10 column that leads straight into the Route 1 exit. I will step right once to align with the gap between Red's house and Blue's sign, then walk up five tiles to reach the entrance to Route 1. -> pressed [right up up up up up]
turn 38: We are at the northern edge of Pallet Town right below the two-tile grass entrance to Route 1. The four tiles directly ahead are clear tall grass, and walking straight north cannot accidentally jump any ledges, so I will press up six times to advance into Route 1. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 39: We are now in Route 1 standing at the top of the Pallet Town entrance corridor with clear dotted path extending at least four tiles straight north. Pressing up six times will move us rapidly north along the path and either keep advancing or stop safely against the first ledge. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 40: We reached the first ledge and sign on Route 1, with the open path passing around the left side of the sign. I will walk left twice through the two tall grass tiles below the sign and then walk up four times onto the clear dotted path and meadow heading north. -> pressed [left left up up up up]
turn 41: We encountered a wild Rattata on Route 1 while Squirtle is at 2/20 HP, so we must run away immediately. I will press b to dismiss the encounter text, then press down and right twice so the cursor lands on RUN as soon as Squirtle's send-out animation finishes, followed by a single a press to escape safely without risking an accidental attack. -> pressed [b down right down right a]
turn 42: Squirtle is actually at full 22/22 HP (auto-healed after the rival battle) and our cursor is already on TACKLE against a wild Lv 3 Rattata. Defeating this Rattata gives ~24 EXP, which combined with the mandatory Lv 9 Weedle Bug Catcher in Viridian Forest will be just enough to push Squirtle to Lv 8 for Bubble without any extra grinding, so I will press a six times to attack with Tackle and advance through the battle. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 43: Squirtle is at 19/22 HP and Rattata is down to just over half HP, with the cursor on FIGHT and Tackle already selected. Pressing a six times will use Tackle immediately, advance through the turn text, and either clear the victory text on a critical hit or automatically queue a final Tackle to finish Rattata off. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 44: We are on the battle menu with Squirtle at 16/22 HP and Lv 3 Rattata down to less than a quarter of its HP, so one more Tackle will finish it off. I will press a twice to select FIGHT and Tackle, then press b four times to clear the KO and EXP text boxes safely without accidentally interacting with the Route 1 sign once we return to the overworld. -> pressed [a a b b b b]
turn 45: We defeated the Lv 3 Rattata and returned to Route 1 with Squirtle at 16/22 HP and enough EXP banked to reach Lv 8 in Viridian Forest. The four tiles straight north of Red through the dotted path and flowers are completely clear, and no ledges can be jumped heading north, so I will press up six times to advance rapidly up Route 1. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 46: We reached the horizontal row of trees on Route 1, and the opening around the east end is four tiles to the right through a strip of tall grass. I will walk right four tiles to clear the trees and then walk up two tiles through the tall grass toward the open path north. -> pressed [right right right right up up]
turn 47: The screen is flashing white for a wild Pokémon encounter in the tall grass on Route 1. I will press b six times to advance quickly through the battle transition, encounter text, and Squirtle's send-out animation so we can land safely on the battle menu and run away. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 48: We are on the battle menu against a wild Lv 3 Pidgey, and we already have enough EXP banked to hit Lv 8 from the mandatory Bug Catcher in Viridian Forest. I will move the cursor to RUN and press a to escape immediately, followed by two b presses to dismiss 'Got away safely!' and an up press to resume heading north on Route 1. -> pressed [down right a b b up]
turn 49: We escaped the wild Pidgey and are now on Route 1 just north of the 4-tree row and tall grass, with a horizontal ledge blocking the path straight north and running all the way to the east border. The grass directly to our left along our current row is completely clear, so I will walk left six tiles to move around the western side of this ledge and find the opening north toward Viridian City. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 50: The horizontal barrier above us runs all the way to the western border wall, and the row of bushes below us also reaches the western wall, making this west side a dead end for heading north. The opening past this ledge must be further east past where we turned back, so I will walk right six tiles along the clear dotted path to head back east. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 51: We are back above the tall grass patch on Route 1 at x=8, and the horizontal middle ledge directly north of us has its northern opening on the far east side of the route (an S-curve around the middle ledge). The path straight east along our current row is completely clear white path with no grass or obstacles visible, so I will walk right six tiles to reach the eastern corridor and find the opening north. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 52: The horizontal ledge above us runs all the way to the eastern fence, so there is no opening north on the east side either. I will walk left six tiles along the clear dotted path above the tall grass to inspect the middle section of the ledge and find the exact opening north toward Viridian City. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 53: We are on Route 1 just above the row of 5 bushes and the tall grass patch, where the horizontal ledge in row 2 has a wooden fence tile two steps left and the dotted path above the ledge turns south near the left edge of the screen. Because we ended up one tile further left than where we exited the tall grass, we must have hit the eastern border on turn 51, meaning we are now at x=11 and walking left six tiles along the clear dotted path will bring us to x=5 so we can inspect the entire western end of this ledge up to the border. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 54: We are back at the west border wall on Route 1, and row 2 consists of two alternating tile types: a smooth horizontal tile directly above us at col 4 and a bumpy ridge tile at col 5. I will press up three times to test whether col 4 is a passable opening, then step right and press up twice so we either keep heading north along the dotted path or test col 5 as well. -> pressed [up up up right up up]
turn 55: We passed through the smooth gap in the middle ledge and are now on the dotted path in northern Route 1, just south of the final ledge and row of bushes. The dotted path extends straight east across the entire right side of the screen (cols 5-9), so I will walk right six tiles to find the northern exit into Viridian City. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 56: We reached the vertical dotted path on northern Route 1, directly below a row of four bushes blocking the way north. To get around the eastern end of the bushes while minimizing tall grass steps, I will walk right once and up twice on the clear dotted path, then step right into the tall grass and head north two tiles past the bushes. -> pressed [right up up right up up]
turn 57: We cleared the row of bushes on northern Route 1 and reached the dotted path below the northern tall grass band. The exit to Viridian City is further west toward the center of the route, and the tiles one step north and four steps west are completely clear of obstacles and tall grass. I will step up onto the dotted path, walk left four tiles toward the center column, and step up once more on clear grass to inspect the path into Viridian City. -> pressed [up left left left left up]
turn 58: We are at the northern section of Route 1, directly south of the final tall grass patch and just right of the vertical column of four bushes that separates the western ledges from the north exit. Walking straight north along this column takes us through the tall grass and directly toward the entrance to Viridian City, so I will press up six times. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 59: We reached the final ledge on northern Route 1, which blocks cols 4-7 right above Red and ends at col 8. I will walk right four tiles through the tall grass to clear the eastern end of the ledge, then walk up two tiles onto the horizontal dotted path that leads straight to the Viridian City entrance. -> pressed [right right right right up up]
turn 60: We encountered a wild Rattata in the northern Route 1 tall grass, and the sprites are already sliding into position. Pressing b three times will advance through the encounter text and Squirtle's send-out animation, after which down, right, and a will move the cursor to RUN and escape immediately. -> pressed [b b b down right a]
turn 61: We accidentally opened the FIGHT move menu against the wild Lv 3 Rattata because the earlier directional presses occurred during the send-out animation. I will press b to return to the battle menu, navigate down and right to RUN, press a to escape, and press b twice to dismiss the escape text. -> pressed [b down right a b b]
turn 62: We escaped the wild Rattata and are standing just past the eastern end of the final ledge on Route 1. I will walk up two tiles onto the clear dotted path above the ledge, walk left three tiles to align with the vertical road entering Viridian City, and step up once to head straight into town without touching any more tall grass. -> pressed [up up left left left up]
turn 63: We are lined up on the right side of the two-tile entrance corridor leading directly north into Viridian City, with clear road visible all the way through the trees. I will press up six times to cross the border and enter Viridian City on our way to the Poké Mart for Oak's Parcel. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 64: We have entered Viridian City and are standing in the southern entrance corridor below the city sign. Walking up three tiles clears the corridor right below the sign, and walking right three tiles moves us east along the clear path toward the Pokémon Center and Poké Mart. -> pressed [up up up right right right]
turn 65: We are in southern Viridian City just below the flower patch and horizontal ledge. The clear path extends straight east along row 4 toward the gap around the ledge and the eastern road leading up to the Poké Mart, so I will walk right six times. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 66: We are on the clear dotted path in southeastern Viridian City just below the flower patches and horizontal ledge. All visible tiles to our right along this row are clear path, so I will walk right six tiles to reach the eastern end of the ledge and turn north toward the Poké Mart. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 67: We hit the eastern border wall of Viridian City, and the horizontal ledge above us runs all the way to the trees (it is a one-way jump south from the Mart). We need to backtrack west to the main road near the southern entrance and head north past the Pokémon Center to reach the Poké Mart, so I will walk left six tiles along the clear dotted path. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 68: We are backtracking west along the clear path south of the eastern ledge in Viridian City. Since we walked straight east along this exact row to reach the eastern wall, walking left six more tiles is completely clear and will bring us back to the main vertical road leading north past the Pokémon Center to the Poké Mart. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 69: We are back near the southern entrance of Viridian City, two tiles right and one tile below the city sign. The horizontal ledge starts at col 1 row 1, while col 0 has an open path heading north into town, so I will walk left four tiles and up two tiles to clear the ledge and head toward the Poké Mart. -> pressed [left left left left up up]
turn 70: Red is aligned on the main vertical road in Viridian City right below the smooth opening in the horizontal ledge, with the Pokémon Center visible to the northeast. Walking straight north along this clear avenue will take us past the Pokémon Center toward the street leading east to the Poké Mart, so I will press up six times. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 71: We are north-northwest of the Viridian City Pokémon Center on the clear open ground, with the Poké Mart located further northeast. All six tiles going two steps north and four steps east are completely clear, so I will walk up twice and right four times to head directly toward the Poké Mart for Oak's Parcel. -> pressed [up up right right right right]
turn 72: The Viridian City Poké Mart is visible at the top right starting at col 9, with its front wall along row 3 and clear open ground along our current row 4 all the way across. Walking right six tiles from col 4 to col 10 will put us directly in front of the Poké Mart entrance so we can step inside and grab Oak's Parcel next turn. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 73: We are directly in front of the Viridian City Poké Mart door. I will step up to enter the Mart, which automatically triggers the clerk's Oak's Parcel cutscene, and press b five times to advance through his dialogue safely without reopening the shop menu. -> pressed [up b b b b b]
turn 74: We received Oak's Parcel from the Viridian Poké Mart clerk. I will press b twice to finish dismissing the item fanfare and the clerk's final line, then step right once to align with the exit mat at x=3 and walk down three tiles toward the front door. -> pressed [b b right down down down]
turn 75: We are outside the Viridian City Poké Mart with Oak's Parcel, and the clear path south of the eastern ledge is 10 tiles straight south of our current position. The flower courtyard directly below us is walkable, so pressing down six times will take us rapidly south toward the one-way ledge shortcut back to the southern exit. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 76: We are in Viridian City just south of the flower garden and directly above the one-way horizontal ledge on row 5. Pressing down will jump over the ledge onto row 6, two more down presses will bring us to the southern horizontal road on row 8 (with row 7 flowers also fully walkable in case a press is eaten by the jump animation), and three left presses will head straight back west toward the Route 1 exit. -> pressed [down down down left left left]
turn 77: We jumped the southern ledge in Viridian City and landed on the clear horizontal road heading west toward the Route 1 exit. Having moved at most three tiles west from the Poké Mart column, walking left six tiles along this open road will align us directly above the two-tile southern exit to Route 1. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 78: Red is already aligned on the left tile of Viridian City's two-tile southern exit corridor, with clear road extending straight south into Route 1. I will press down six times to exit Viridian City and enter northern Route 1 so we can jump the one-way ledges back to Pallet Town. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 79: We are at the northern entrance of Route 1 with clear dotted path south and an open plain grass strip below the fence leading west past the vertical bush column. Heading west first lets us take the western one-way ledges straight down Route 1 with zero tall grass encounters, so I will step down twice and left four times. -> pressed [down down left left left left]
turn 80: We are on the western side of northern Route 1 directly above the first one-way ledge, with completely clear plain grass and flowers extending straight south and zero tall grass. Pressing down six times will walk down to the ledge, jump over it, and continue straight south down the encounter-free western shortcut toward Pallet Town. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 81: We jumped the first western ledge on Route 1 and are lined up directly above the next one-way ledge three tiles south, with completely clear grass and zero tall grass ahead. Pressing down six times will walk to the ledge, jump over it, and continue straight south along the encounter-free western shortcut toward Pallet Town. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 82: We are on the western side of Route 1 with clear path leading two tiles south to the next one-way ledge at row 7, followed by more clear path beyond it. Pressing down six times will walk to the ledge, jump over it, and continue straight south toward southern Route 1 and Pallet Town. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 83: We hit the long horizontal row of bushes in the middle of Route 1, which runs from the west wall all the way past the right edge of the screen. Row 4 directly to our right is completely clear plain grass with no tall grass or obstacles, so I will walk right six tiles to get around the eastern end of the bushes. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 84: We cleared the horizontal row of bushes on Route 1 and are on the western edge of the tall grass patch, which extends three tiles south before opening onto clear path. Heading straight south minimizes tall grass steps and takes us directly over the southern one-way ledge toward the Pallet Town entrance, so I will press down six times. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 85: We encountered a wild Pidgey in the Route 1 tall grass ('Wild PIDGEY appeared!'). Pressing b four times will safely clear the encounter text and Squirtle's send-out animation without accidentally opening FIGHT, and finishing with down and right will move the battle menu cursor onto RUN so we can escape immediately and resume heading south next turn. -> pressed [b b b b down right]
turn 86: We are on the battle menu against a wild Lv 2 Pidgey with the cursor on PKMN. We already have enough EXP banked to reach Lv 8 from the mandatory Viridian Forest Bug Catcher, so I will press down and a to select RUN, press b twice to clear the escape text, and press down twice to continue heading south down Route 1. -> pressed [down a b b down down]
turn 87: We escaped the wild Pidgey on southern Route 1, just north of the final ledge and sign. Stepping left onto the flowers immediately exits the tall grass with zero encounter risk, and walking straight south jumps the ledge directly onto the dotted path leading into Pallet Town. -> pressed [left down down down down down]
turn 88: We jumped the final Route 1 ledge and are standing just north of the two-tile entrance corridor back into Pallet Town. Stepping left once aligns us with the western column of the corridor (x=10), which avoids Blue's house once inside Pallet Town, and walking down five times takes us straight into Pallet Town on our way to Oak's Lab. -> pressed [left down down down down down]
turn 89: We encountered a wild Pidgey in the final tall grass strip right at the Pallet Town entrance, and the battle sprites are currently sliding in. Pressing b four times will safely advance through the encounter text and Squirtle's send-out animation without opening FIGHT, and finishing with down and right will move the cursor toward RUN if the battle menu opens in time. -> pressed [b b b b down right]
turn 90: We are on the battle menu against a wild Lv 3 Pidgey at the Pallet Town entrance with the cursor on PKMN. I will press down and a to select RUN, press b twice to dismiss the escape text, and press down twice to finish entering Pallet Town on our way to Oak's Lab. -> pressed [down a b b down down]
turn 91: We escaped the wild Pidgey and are in the western column (x=10) of the tall grass corridor entering Pallet Town, with two grass tiles left before open town ground. Pressing down six times will clear the tall grass immediately and walk straight south between Red's house and Blue's house toward Professor Oak's Lab. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 92: We are back in Pallet Town just left of Blue's house sign, with Oak's Lab visible directly south of us. Walking left once clears the west wall of Oak's Lab, and walking down five times brings us smoothly down the open column alongside the lab toward its front entrance. -> pressed [left down down down down down]
turn 93: We are in Pallet Town just west of Professor Oak's Lab, two rows above the front path and three columns left of the lab entrance. Walking down twice, right three times, and up once will take us straight through the door into Oak's Lab to deliver Oak's Parcel. -> pressed [down down right right right up]
turn 94: We are inside Professor Oak's Lab on the right tile of the entrance mat, directly aligned with the center aisle leading straight up to Professor Oak. All tiles straight north are completely clear, so I will walk up six times to approach Oak and deliver Oak's Parcel. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 95: We are in the center aisle of Professor Oak's Lab, two tiles directly south of Professor Oak with clear floor between us. I will walk up twice to stand in front of Oak, press a to talk to him and deliver Oak's Parcel, and press b three times to start clearing the Pokédex cutscene dialogue. -> pressed [up up a b b b]
turn 96: We are speaking with Professor Oak to deliver Oak's Parcel ('You must be talented as a'). The parcel delivery and Pokédex cutscene involves many dialogue boxes and Blue's arrival, so I will press b six times to advance quickly. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 97: We just delivered Oak's Parcel ('RED delivered OAK's PARCEL.'). Next comes Blue walking in and Oak's lengthy Pokédex presentation cutscene, so I will press b six times to advance through the dialogue quickly. -> pressed [b b b b b b]

turn 1: We are on the Game Freak intro screen. I will press start and a several times to skip the intro, get past the title screen, and start a new game. -> pressed [start start a a a a]
turn 2: Professor Oak is giving his intro speech ('My name is OAK! People call me'). I will press b six times to advance through his dialogue quickly without accidentally opening the custom name entry screen. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 3: Oak is still explaining Pokémon with Nidorino on screen ('For some people, POKéMON are'). I will press b six times to advance through the remaining intro text and land safely on the player name selection menu without accidentally choosing NEW NAME. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 4: We are on the player name menu with the cursor on NEW NAME. I will press down and a to pick RED, then press b four times to advance through the rival intro text and land safely on the rival name selection menu. -> pressed [down a b b b b]
turn 5: Oak is at the end of 'your rival since you were a baby.' with the advance arrow visible. I will press b three times to safely clear the '...Erm, what is his name again?' prompt and land on the rival name menu, then press down and a to pick BLUE, and b to start advancing Oak's final intro dialogue. -> pressed [b b b down a b]
turn 6: Oak says 'remember now! His name is BLUE!' with the advance arrow showing. I will press b six times to clear the final few intro text boxes and enter Red's bedroom. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 7: We are on the very last line of Oak's intro ('with POKéMON awaits! Let's go!'). I will press b to dismiss the text and start the game, then press right and up to head toward the top-right bedroom stairs once the fade-in finishes (skipping the PC Potion to save turns). -> pressed [b right right right up up]
turn 8: We are in Red's bedroom at (5, 4), and the stairs are two tiles right and three tiles up at (7, 1). I will walk right twice and up three times to go downstairs, adding a down press in case the warp finishes quickly. -> pressed [right right up up up down]
turn 9: We are downstairs in Red's house just below the stairs at (7, 2), and the floor along the right side down to row y=6 and over to x=5 is completely clear. I will walk down four tiles and left two tiles to get around Mom and the table, lining up to exit through the front door next turn. -> pressed [down down down down left left]
turn 10: Red is at (5, 6) in the living room, two tiles right and one tile above the right side of the front doormat at (3, 7). I will walk left twice and down twice to step onto the doormat and exit into Pallet Town, then press right twice to start heading east toward the north exit to Route 1 once outside. -> pressed [left left down down right right]
turn 11: We are outside in Pallet Town just east of Red's front door at (7, 6), and the path east and then north between Red's house and Blue's house is completely clear. I will walk right three tiles to align with the Route 1 tall grass exit at x=10, then walk up three tiles toward the north exit to trigger Professor Oak. -> pressed [right right right up up up]
turn 12: We are lined up directly below the left tile of the Route 1 tall grass in Pallet Town, two steps away from entering it. I will walk up twice to step into the grass and trigger Professor Oak's intervention, then press b four times to start clearing his dialogue. -> pressed [up up b b b b]
turn 13: Professor Oak has stopped Red at the Route 1 tall grass and is saying 'Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!'. I will press b six times to clear the rest of his dialogue and trigger the cutscene walk to Oak's Lab. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 14: We have arrived in Professor Oak's Lab and Blue is starting his speech ('BLUE: Gramps! I'm fed up with'). There are many text boxes of dialogue before we gain control to choose Squirtle from the middle Poké Ball, so I will press b six times to advance quickly. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 15: Oak is still explaining the three starter Poké Balls ('There are 3 POKéMON here!'). There are several more text boxes of dialogue between Oak and Blue before we gain control, so I will press b six times to advance quickly through them. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 16: Oak is nearing the end of his starter speech ('have only 3 left, but you can have'), followed by Blue interrupting and Oak telling him to be patient. There are about six text box advances remaining before we gain control, so I will press b six times to clear the rest of the dialogue. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 17: We now have control in Professor Oak's Lab, standing at (4, 4) directly left of the starter table. The middle Poké Ball at (6, 4) holds Squirtle, so I will walk down once, right twice, face up, and press a twice to inspect and confirm Squirtle. -> pressed [down right right up a a]
turn 18: We are viewing page 1 of Squirtle's Pokédex entry. I will press a five times to advance through page 2, close the Pokédex, and confirm YES to choose Squirtle as our starter, followed by a b press to start advancing through the post-selection text without risking a nickname prompt. -> pressed [a a a a a b]
turn 19: We have chosen Squirtle and the screen says 'RED received a SQUIRTLE!'. I will press b six times to dismiss the fanfare text, decline giving Squirtle a nickname, and advance through Blue's cutscene as he picks Bulbasaur. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 20: Blue has just received Bulbasaur and the text box is waiting to be dismissed. Since there are bookshelves below our current column, I will press b to close the text, walk left two tiles into the center aisle, and walk down three tiles to trigger the rival battle with Blue. -> pressed [b left left down down down]
turn 21: We triggered the rival battle with Blue ('BLUE: Wait RED!'). I will press b six times to advance through his pre-battle dialogue, let him walk over, and progress through the battle intro. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 22: The rival battle with Blue has just started and the trainers are sliding into position. Pressing a six times will advance through the opening battle text and immediately select FIGHT and TACKLE once the menu appears. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 23: Squirtle has just been sent out against Blue's Lv 5 Bulbasaur ('Go! SQUIRTLE!'). Squirtle's much higher Defense gives us a strong edge in a Tackle race, and pressing a repeatedly will both advance battle text and automatically select FIGHT and TACKLE. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 24: Squirtle is at 17/20 HP and just used Tackle on Blue's Lv 5 Bulbasaur, which still has most of its HP remaining. I will press a six times to advance through the attack animations and continue using Tackle. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 25: Squirtle is at 14/20 HP against Blue's Lv 5 Bulbasaur, which still has about 80% HP left. Using Tail Whip once will drop Bulbasaur's Defense and boost Tackle's damage enough to win the damage race before Squirtle faints, so I will open FIGHT, select Tail Whip, and use b presses to advance the turn text safely without accidentally using Tail Whip twice. -> pressed [a down a b b b]
turn 26: Squirtle is at 11/20 HP and is currently using Tail Whip to lower Bulbasaur's Defense. Because the move cursor will remember Tail Whip, I will press b twice to finish the turn text, press a to open FIGHT, press up to move the cursor back to Tackle, press a to attack with Tackle, and press b to advance the resulting text safely. -> pressed [b b a up a b]
turn 27: Bulbasaur just used Tackle and dropped Squirtle to 8/20 HP, which confirms our move went through last turn and Squirtle is about to attack with Tackle against Bulbasaur's lowered Defense. With the move cursor back on Tackle, I will press a six times to advance the battle text and keep using Tackle. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 28: Squirtle is at 8/20 HP and just landed Tackle on Bulbasaur, knocking it down to roughly half HP after Tail Whip's Defense drop. Since our cursor is on Tackle and we are on pace to KO Bulbasaur in two more hits before fainting, I will press a six times to keep attacking with Tackle and advance the battle text. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 29: We are on the battle menu with Squirtle at 8/20 HP and Bulbasaur down to less than a third of its HP bar (it likely used Growl instead of attacking). Since the cursor is on FIGHT and our last move was Tackle, pressing a six times will immediately use Tackle and advance through the turn text to finish off Bulbasaur. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 30: Squirtle (8/20 HP) is currently attacking Bulbasaur with Tackle while Bulbasaur has around a quarter of its HP left. Pressing a six times will either advance through the KO, level-up, and victory dialogue if this Tackle finishes Bulbasaur, or immediately select FIGHT and Tackle again if Bulbasaur barely survives. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 31: We are on the battle menu with Squirtle at 5/20 HP and Bulbasaur down to a tiny sliver of HP. Pressing a twice will select FIGHT and Tackle to knock out Bulbasaur, and the remaining a presses will advance through the KO, level-up, and victory text (or immediately use Tackle again in the rare event of a miss). -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 32: Enemy Bulbasaur fainted and Squirtle survived with 2/20 HP to win the rival battle! I will press b six times to advance through the EXP gain, level-up stat screen, prize money, and Blue's post-battle dialogue. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 33: Squirtle leveled up to Lv 6 and we see 'RED defeated BLUE!' on the victory screen. I will press b six times to advance through Blue's defeat quote, the prize money, and his post-battle dialogue in Oak's Lab. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 34: Blue is giving his post-battle speech in Oak's Lab ('BLUE: Okay! I'll make my'). Pressing b four times will clear his remaining lines and trigger his exit cutscene, and pressing down twice afterward will start walking straight toward the lab's front door once we regain control. -> pressed [b b b b down down]
turn 35: We have regained control in Professor Oak's Lab, standing three tiles above the exit mat in the center aisle. I will walk down four times to step onto the mat and exit into Pallet Town, then walk left twice to begin rounding the west side of Oak's Lab toward Route 1. -> pressed [down down down down left left]
turn 36: We are outside Professor Oak's Lab in Pallet Town, standing just below its southwest corner. The column immediately to our left is completely clear alongside the lab's west wall, so I will step left once and walk up five tiles to head north toward Route 1. -> pressed [left up up up up up]
turn 37: We are in Pallet Town at (9, 7), one tile left of the x=10 column that leads straight into the Route 1 exit. I will step right once to align with the gap between Red's house and Blue's sign, then walk up five tiles to reach the entrance to Route 1. -> pressed [right up up up up up]
turn 38: We are at the northern edge of Pallet Town right below the two-tile grass entrance to Route 1. The four tiles directly ahead are clear tall grass, and walking straight north cannot accidentally jump any ledges, so I will press up six times to advance into Route 1. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 39: We are now in Route 1 standing at the top of the Pallet Town entrance corridor with clear dotted path extending at least four tiles straight north. Pressing up six times will move us rapidly north along the path and either keep advancing or stop safely against the first ledge. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 40: We reached the first ledge and sign on Route 1, with the open path passing around the left side of the sign. I will walk left twice through the two tall grass tiles below the sign and then walk up four times onto the clear dotted path and meadow heading north. -> pressed [left left up up up up]
turn 41: We encountered a wild Rattata on Route 1 while Squirtle is at 2/20 HP, so we must run away immediately. I will press b to dismiss the encounter text, then press down and right twice so the cursor lands on RUN as soon as Squirtle's send-out animation finishes, followed by a single a press to escape safely without risking an accidental attack. -> pressed [b down right down right a]
turn 42: Squirtle is actually at full 22/22 HP (auto-healed after the rival battle) and our cursor is already on TACKLE against a wild Lv 3 Rattata. Defeating this Rattata gives ~24 EXP, which combined with the mandatory Lv 9 Weedle Bug Catcher in Viridian Forest will be just enough to push Squirtle to Lv 8 for Bubble without any extra grinding, so I will press a six times to attack with Tackle and advance through the battle. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 43: Squirtle is at 19/22 HP and Rattata is down to just over half HP, with the cursor on FIGHT and Tackle already selected. Pressing a six times will use Tackle immediately, advance through the turn text, and either clear the victory text on a critical hit or automatically queue a final Tackle to finish Rattata off. -> pressed [a a a a a a]
turn 44: We are on the battle menu with Squirtle at 16/22 HP and Lv 3 Rattata down to less than a quarter of its HP, so one more Tackle will finish it off. I will press a twice to select FIGHT and Tackle, then press b four times to clear the KO and EXP text boxes safely without accidentally interacting with the Route 1 sign once we return to the overworld. -> pressed [a a b b b b]
turn 45: We defeated the Lv 3 Rattata and returned to Route 1 with Squirtle at 16/22 HP and enough EXP banked to reach Lv 8 in Viridian Forest. The four tiles straight north of Red through the dotted path and flowers are completely clear, and no ledges can be jumped heading north, so I will press up six times to advance rapidly up Route 1. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 46: We reached the horizontal row of trees on Route 1, and the opening around the east end is four tiles to the right through a strip of tall grass. I will walk right four tiles to clear the trees and then walk up two tiles through the tall grass toward the open path north. -> pressed [right right right right up up]
turn 47: The screen is flashing white for a wild Pokémon encounter in the tall grass on Route 1. I will press b six times to advance quickly through the battle transition, encounter text, and Squirtle's send-out animation so we can land safely on the battle menu and run away. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 48: We are on the battle menu against a wild Lv 3 Pidgey, and we already have enough EXP banked to hit Lv 8 from the mandatory Bug Catcher in Viridian Forest. I will move the cursor to RUN and press a to escape immediately, followed by two b presses to dismiss 'Got away safely!' and an up press to resume heading north on Route 1. -> pressed [down right a b b up]
turn 49: We escaped the wild Pidgey and are now on Route 1 just north of the 4-tree row and tall grass, with a horizontal ledge blocking the path straight north and running all the way to the east border. The grass directly to our left along our current row is completely clear, so I will walk left six tiles to move around the western side of this ledge and find the opening north toward Viridian City. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 50: The horizontal barrier above us runs all the way to the western border wall, and the row of bushes below us also reaches the western wall, making this west side a dead end for heading north. The opening past this ledge must be further east past where we turned back, so I will walk right six tiles along the clear dotted path to head back east. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 51: We are back above the tall grass patch on Route 1 at x=8, and the horizontal middle ledge directly north of us has its northern opening on the far east side of the route (an S-curve around the middle ledge). The path straight east along our current row is completely clear white path with no grass or obstacles visible, so I will walk right six tiles to reach the eastern corridor and find the opening north. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 52: The horizontal ledge above us runs all the way to the eastern fence, so there is no opening north on the east side either. I will walk left six tiles along the clear dotted path above the tall grass to inspect the middle section of the ledge and find the exact opening north toward Viridian City. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 53: We are on Route 1 just above the row of 5 bushes and the tall grass patch, where the horizontal ledge in row 2 has a wooden fence tile two steps left and the dotted path above the ledge turns south near the left edge of the screen. Because we ended up one tile further left than where we exited the tall grass, we must have hit the eastern border on turn 51, meaning we are now at x=11 and walking left six tiles along the clear dotted path will bring us to x=5 so we can inspect the entire western end of this ledge up to the border. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 54: We are back at the west border wall on Route 1, and row 2 consists of two alternating tile types: a smooth horizontal tile directly above us at col 4 and a bumpy ridge tile at col 5. I will press up three times to test whether col 4 is a passable opening, then step right and press up twice so we either keep heading north along the dotted path or test col 5 as well. -> pressed [up up up right up up]
turn 55: We passed through the smooth gap in the middle ledge and are now on the dotted path in northern Route 1, just south of the final ledge and row of bushes. The dotted path extends straight east across the entire right side of the screen (cols 5-9), so I will walk right six tiles to find the northern exit into Viridian City. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 56: We reached the vertical dotted path on northern Route 1, directly below a row of four bushes blocking the way north. To get around the eastern end of the bushes while minimizing tall grass steps, I will walk right once and up twice on the clear dotted path, then step right into the tall grass and head north two tiles past the bushes. -> pressed [right up up right up up]
turn 57: We cleared the row of bushes on northern Route 1 and reached the dotted path below the northern tall grass band. The exit to Viridian City is further west toward the center of the route, and the tiles one step north and four steps west are completely clear of obstacles and tall grass. I will step up onto the dotted path, walk left four tiles toward the center column, and step up once more on clear grass to inspect the path into Viridian City. -> pressed [up left left left left up]
turn 58: We are at the northern section of Route 1, directly south of the final tall grass patch and just right of the vertical column of four bushes that separates the western ledges from the north exit. Walking straight north along this column takes us through the tall grass and directly toward the entrance to Viridian City, so I will press up six times. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 59: We reached the final ledge on northern Route 1, which blocks cols 4-7 right above Red and ends at col 8. I will walk right four tiles through the tall grass to clear the eastern end of the ledge, then walk up two tiles onto the horizontal dotted path that leads straight to the Viridian City entrance. -> pressed [right right right right up up]
turn 60: We encountered a wild Rattata in the northern Route 1 tall grass, and the sprites are already sliding into position. Pressing b three times will advance through the encounter text and Squirtle's send-out animation, after which down, right, and a will move the cursor to RUN and escape immediately. -> pressed [b b b down right a]
turn 61: We accidentally opened the FIGHT move menu against the wild Lv 3 Rattata because the earlier directional presses occurred during the send-out animation. I will press b to return to the battle menu, navigate down and right to RUN, press a to escape, and press b twice to dismiss the escape text. -> pressed [b down right a b b]
turn 62: We escaped the wild Rattata and are standing just past the eastern end of the final ledge on Route 1. I will walk up two tiles onto the clear dotted path above the ledge, walk left three tiles to align with the vertical road entering Viridian City, and step up once to head straight into town without touching any more tall grass. -> pressed [up up left left left up]
turn 63: We are lined up on the right side of the two-tile entrance corridor leading directly north into Viridian City, with clear road visible all the way through the trees. I will press up six times to cross the border and enter Viridian City on our way to the Poké Mart for Oak's Parcel. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 64: We have entered Viridian City and are standing in the southern entrance corridor below the city sign. Walking up three tiles clears the corridor right below the sign, and walking right three tiles moves us east along the clear path toward the Pokémon Center and Poké Mart. -> pressed [up up up right right right]
turn 65: We are in southern Viridian City just below the flower patch and horizontal ledge. The clear path extends straight east along row 4 toward the gap around the ledge and the eastern road leading up to the Poké Mart, so I will walk right six times. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 66: We are on the clear dotted path in southeastern Viridian City just below the flower patches and horizontal ledge. All visible tiles to our right along this row are clear path, so I will walk right six tiles to reach the eastern end of the ledge and turn north toward the Poké Mart. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 67: We hit the eastern border wall of Viridian City, and the horizontal ledge above us runs all the way to the trees (it is a one-way jump south from the Mart). We need to backtrack west to the main road near the southern entrance and head north past the Pokémon Center to reach the Poké Mart, so I will walk left six tiles along the clear dotted path. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 68: We are backtracking west along the clear path south of the eastern ledge in Viridian City. Since we walked straight east along this exact row to reach the eastern wall, walking left six more tiles is completely clear and will bring us back to the main vertical road leading north past the Pokémon Center to the Poké Mart. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 69: We are back near the southern entrance of Viridian City, two tiles right and one tile below the city sign. The horizontal ledge starts at col 1 row 1, while col 0 has an open path heading north into town, so I will walk left four tiles and up two tiles to clear the ledge and head toward the Poké Mart. -> pressed [left left left left up up]
turn 70: Red is aligned on the main vertical road in Viridian City right below the smooth opening in the horizontal ledge, with the Pokémon Center visible to the northeast. Walking straight north along this clear avenue will take us past the Pokémon Center toward the street leading east to the Poké Mart, so I will press up six times. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 71: We are north-northwest of the Viridian City Pokémon Center on the clear open ground, with the Poké Mart located further northeast. All six tiles going two steps north and four steps east are completely clear, so I will walk up twice and right four times to head directly toward the Poké Mart for Oak's Parcel. -> pressed [up up right right right right]
turn 72: The Viridian City Poké Mart is visible at the top right starting at col 9, with its front wall along row 3 and clear open ground along our current row 4 all the way across. Walking right six tiles from col 4 to col 10 will put us directly in front of the Poké Mart entrance so we can step inside and grab Oak's Parcel next turn. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 73: We are directly in front of the Viridian City Poké Mart door. I will step up to enter the Mart, which automatically triggers the clerk's Oak's Parcel cutscene, and press b five times to advance through his dialogue safely without reopening the shop menu. -> pressed [up b b b b b]
turn 74: We received Oak's Parcel from the Viridian Poké Mart clerk. I will press b twice to finish dismissing the item fanfare and the clerk's final line, then step right once to align with the exit mat at x=3 and walk down three tiles toward the front door. -> pressed [b b right down down down]
turn 75: We are outside the Viridian City Poké Mart with Oak's Parcel, and the clear path south of the eastern ledge is 10 tiles straight south of our current position. The flower courtyard directly below us is walkable, so pressing down six times will take us rapidly south toward the one-way ledge shortcut back to the southern exit. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 76: We are in Viridian City just south of the flower garden and directly above the one-way horizontal ledge on row 5. Pressing down will jump over the ledge onto row 6, two more down presses will bring us to the southern horizontal road on row 8 (with row 7 flowers also fully walkable in case a press is eaten by the jump animation), and three left presses will head straight back west toward the Route 1 exit. -> pressed [down down down left left left]
turn 77: We jumped the southern ledge in Viridian City and landed on the clear horizontal road heading west toward the Route 1 exit. Having moved at most three tiles west from the Poké Mart column, walking left six tiles along this open road will align us directly above the two-tile southern exit to Route 1. -> pressed [left left left left left left]
turn 78: Red is already aligned on the left tile of Viridian City's two-tile southern exit corridor, with clear road extending straight south into Route 1. I will press down six times to exit Viridian City and enter northern Route 1 so we can jump the one-way ledges back to Pallet Town. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 79: We are at the northern entrance of Route 1 with clear dotted path south and an open plain grass strip below the fence leading west past the vertical bush column. Heading west first lets us take the western one-way ledges straight down Route 1 with zero tall grass encounters, so I will step down twice and left four times. -> pressed [down down left left left left]
turn 80: We are on the western side of northern Route 1 directly above the first one-way ledge, with completely clear plain grass and flowers extending straight south and zero tall grass. Pressing down six times will walk down to the ledge, jump over it, and continue straight south down the encounter-free western shortcut toward Pallet Town. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 81: We jumped the first western ledge on Route 1 and are lined up directly above the next one-way ledge three tiles south, with completely clear grass and zero tall grass ahead. Pressing down six times will walk to the ledge, jump over it, and continue straight south along the encounter-free western shortcut toward Pallet Town. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 82: We are on the western side of Route 1 with clear path leading two tiles south to the next one-way ledge at row 7, followed by more clear path beyond it. Pressing down six times will walk to the ledge, jump over it, and continue straight south toward southern Route 1 and Pallet Town. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 83: We hit the long horizontal row of bushes in the middle of Route 1, which runs from the west wall all the way past the right edge of the screen. Row 4 directly to our right is completely clear plain grass with no tall grass or obstacles, so I will walk right six tiles to get around the eastern end of the bushes. -> pressed [right right right right right right]
turn 84: We cleared the horizontal row of bushes on Route 1 and are on the western edge of the tall grass patch, which extends three tiles south before opening onto clear path. Heading straight south minimizes tall grass steps and takes us directly over the southern one-way ledge toward the Pallet Town entrance, so I will press down six times. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 85: We encountered a wild Pidgey in the Route 1 tall grass ('Wild PIDGEY appeared!'). Pressing b four times will safely clear the encounter text and Squirtle's send-out animation without accidentally opening FIGHT, and finishing with down and right will move the battle menu cursor onto RUN so we can escape immediately and resume heading south next turn. -> pressed [b b b b down right]
turn 86: We are on the battle menu against a wild Lv 2 Pidgey with the cursor on PKMN. We already have enough EXP banked to reach Lv 8 from the mandatory Viridian Forest Bug Catcher, so I will press down and a to select RUN, press b twice to clear the escape text, and press down twice to continue heading south down Route 1. -> pressed [down a b b down down]
turn 87: We escaped the wild Pidgey on southern Route 1, just north of the final ledge and sign. Stepping left onto the flowers immediately exits the tall grass with zero encounter risk, and walking straight south jumps the ledge directly onto the dotted path leading into Pallet Town. -> pressed [left down down down down down]
turn 88: We jumped the final Route 1 ledge and are standing just north of the two-tile entrance corridor back into Pallet Town. Stepping left once aligns us with the western column of the corridor (x=10), which avoids Blue's house once inside Pallet Town, and walking down five times takes us straight into Pallet Town on our way to Oak's Lab. -> pressed [left down down down down down]
turn 89: We encountered a wild Pidgey in the final tall grass strip right at the Pallet Town entrance, and the battle sprites are currently sliding in. Pressing b four times will safely advance through the encounter text and Squirtle's send-out animation without opening FIGHT, and finishing with down and right will move the cursor toward RUN if the battle menu opens in time. -> pressed [b b b b down right]
turn 90: We are on the battle menu against a wild Lv 3 Pidgey at the Pallet Town entrance with the cursor on PKMN. I will press down and a to select RUN, press b twice to dismiss the escape text, and press down twice to finish entering Pallet Town on our way to Oak's Lab. -> pressed [down a b b down down]
turn 91: We escaped the wild Pidgey and are in the western column (x=10) of the tall grass corridor entering Pallet Town, with two grass tiles left before open town ground. Pressing down six times will clear the tall grass immediately and walk straight south between Red's house and Blue's house toward Professor Oak's Lab. -> pressed [down down down down down down]
turn 92: We are back in Pallet Town just left of Blue's house sign, with Oak's Lab visible directly south of us. Walking left once clears the west wall of Oak's Lab, and walking down five times brings us smoothly down the open column alongside the lab toward its front entrance. -> pressed [left down down down down down]
turn 93: We are in Pallet Town just west of Professor Oak's Lab, two rows above the front path and three columns left of the lab entrance. Walking down twice, right three times, and up once will take us straight through the door into Oak's Lab to deliver Oak's Parcel. -> pressed [down down right right right up]
turn 94: We are inside Professor Oak's Lab on the right tile of the entrance mat, directly aligned with the center aisle leading straight up to Professor Oak. All tiles straight north are completely clear, so I will walk up six times to approach Oak and deliver Oak's Parcel. -> pressed [up up up up up up]
turn 95: We are in the center aisle of Professor Oak's Lab, two tiles directly south of Professor Oak with clear floor between us. I will walk up twice to stand in front of Oak, press a to talk to him and deliver Oak's Parcel, and press b three times to start clearing the Pokédex cutscene dialogue. -> pressed [up up a b b b]
turn 96: We are speaking with Professor Oak to deliver Oak's Parcel ('You must be talented as a'). The parcel delivery and Pokédex cutscene involves many dialogue boxes and Blue's arrival, so I will press b six times to advance quickly. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
turn 97: We just delivered Oak's Parcel ('RED delivered OAK's PARCEL.'). Next comes Blue walking in and Oak's lengthy Pokédex presentation cutscene, so I will press b six times to advance through the dialogue quickly. -> pressed [b b b b b b]
